story.headline: Stanford's Karl Deisseroth shares the 2026 Nobel Prize in medicine for optogenetics
story.summary: Karl Deisseroth, a Stanford University and Howard Hughes Medical Institute professor, was named on Oct. 5 as a joint winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Germany's Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel. Deisseroth put the gene for a light-sensitive algae protein into rodent neurons, making it possible to switch specific brain cells on and off with light. The technique, known as optogenetics, is now widely used to study how the brain works.
